278799965.description:
Nirvana Smoking Pipe
Estate Wood Tobacco Pipe
Polished Wood, 6.5 Inches, With Box
A classic Nirvana estate tobacco pipe featuring a polished wood bowl and a distinctive bent stem design. Nirvana pipes are recognized for their traditional aesthetic and accessible quality, often featuring a deep mahogany-colored finish and decorative metal bands. This example includes its original cardboard presentation box, making it a complete set for collectors or enthusiasts of vintage-style smoking accessories.
Polished wood construction with a classic bent billiard silhouette
Black curved stem featuring a decorative silver-tone accent band
Original brown "Nirvana Pipe" cardboard presentation box included
Approximately 6.5 inches in length with a substantial bowl depth
Condition:
The bowl interior shows carbonization consistent with previous use. The exterior wood finish is well-preserved with a high gloss and no significant scratches or dings. The stem is in good condition without visible oxidation or teeth chatter. The original box shows light storage wear including a small fray at the top corner, but remains structurally sound.
